name: test-plan
description: 基于已确认的 spec.md 生成 checklist 形式的 test-plan.md。每条验收项必须用 `- [ ] cmd:` 或 `- [ ] human:` 之一明确标记，供 Verification 阶段两段式判定。用户确认后方可进入 Tasking。当 TDD 模式开启时，确认后自动为每个 cmd 检查项生成对应的单元测试代码骨架（Red 状态）。

options.label: TDD 模式
options.description: 开启后，用户确认 test-plan.md 后自动为每个 cmd 检查项生成对应的单元测试代码骨架（Red 状态）

prompt.instruction:
## Phase 1 — 生成 test-plan.md

Read every AC-N and FR-N from spec.md. For each, derive one or more checklist items that prove or disprove it. Use exactly two prefixes:
- '- [ ] cmd: <shell>' — **自动化测试**：单元测试、接口测试、shell 命令验证等。机器自动执行，exit code == 0 视为通过。典型场景：运行单元测试套件、调用 API 检查返回值、grep 验证文件内容、JSON schema 校验。
- '- [ ] human: <描述>' — **功能测试**：在页面 / 客户端上实际操作（点击按钮、输入表单、切换主题、刷新页面等），由用户手动执行并确认。典型场景：UI 交互流程、视觉效果验证、端到端用户旅程。

Organize items into groups labelled G1, G2, ... with a one-line 'Pass criterion' summary at the end of each group. The very last item of the document MUST be 'cmd: tail -n 1 verification.log | grep -q "ALL PASSED"'.

Write test-plan.md to disk and present it to the user for confirmation.

## Phase 2 — 生成测试代码（TDD 模式，确认后执行）

ONLY proceed to this phase after the user explicitly confirms test-plan.md (says 同意/approve/确认).

If the user rejects with feedback: go back to Phase 1, update test-plan.md with the feedback, and re-present for confirmation.

When options.tdd == true AND user has confirmed:
1. Detect the project's test framework (JUnit/Mocha/pytest/etc.) and test directory convention from the worktree (run://../).
2. For each '- [ ] cmd:' checklist item in the confirmed test-plan.md, generate a corresponding test method/function stub in the appropriate test file.
3. Each test stub must: (a) have a descriptive name matching the checklist item ID (e.g., testG1_cmd1_xxx), (b) contain Arrange/Act/Assert comments outlining the test logic, (c) be marked as pending/skip/throw to indicate 'Red' state (not yet implemented).
4. Write test files to the detected test directory under the worktree. If no test directory exists, create one following the framework convention.
5. Append a '## TDD 测试文件' section to test-plan.md listing each generated test file, its checklist mapping, and current status (Red).
6. The test code should be concrete enough to run after the implementation is filled in — not just TODO placeholders.

When options.tdd == false: skip Phase 2 entirely, the task is complete after Phase 1 confirmation.
guardrails: Each checklist line MUST start with either '- [ ] cmd:' or '- [ ] human:' — no other prefixes are valid.
cmd: items are automated tests (unit tests, API tests, shell verification). They must be runnable in the targetDir working directory without sudo and without network.
human: items are functional tests (UI interaction, visual verification, end-to-end user flows). Describe the exact steps the user should perform and what they should observe.
Each group must end with a 'Pass criterion' line so report aggregation works.
Cover every AC-N from spec.md with at least one checklist item.

Prefer cmd: for anything verifiable by code (file existence, content matching, test execution, API calls). Reserve human: for things that truly require visual or interactive judgement (UI layout, animation, click-through flows).
Phase 2 MUST NOT start until user explicitly confirms test-plan.md. A selection among options is NOT confirmation.
When TDD mode is on, test stubs MUST be runnable (compile-ready) even though they are in Red state — no syntax errors, no missing imports.
When TDD mode is on, do NOT generate tests for 'human:' items — only 'cmd:' items get test stubs.
